name: emitting-mid-callback-never-re-enters-the-guest
note: ABI §6.2's `emit` enqueues; it does not deliver. The block emits three times inside start and three more inside a delivery, checking its own callback depth after each, and latches anything it finds. The latch is returned by eio_stop, so a host that re-entered fails at the stop step even if every other expectation held — the evidence outlives the moment it happened in.
